items.title: 阶跃星辰发布 Step Plan 包月订阅方案，主打 OpenClaw 场景！开发者社区半价大放送
items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网讯 3 月 23 日，阶跃星辰正式官宣推出月度 token 订阅方案 Step Plan。该方案针对 OpenClaw 及 AI Coding 场景深度定制。首发支持 Step 3.5 Flash，该模型目前在OpenRouter 总调用周榜全球第一，及 OpenRouter OpenClaw 应用月榜调用量全球第一。   随着 OpenClaw 等 Agent 产品形态的爆发，开发者正面临巨大的成本挑战。阶跃星辰推出的 Step Plan 设置 4 个不同档位方案：Flash Mini、Flash Plus、Flash Pro、Flash Max。起步价 49 元/月，开发者社区限时半价低至 25 元/月。值得关注的是，Step Plan 全档位统一提供高速推理速度，不设"普通版"和"极速版"的区分。在不少同类产品将高速推理作为付费升级项的行业背景下，阶跃星辰选择把极速体验做成标配，让所有用户开箱即享。   随着 Agent 开发工具（如 OpenClaw、Claude Code）的普及，国内大模型厂商正掀起一场针对开发者的“Coding Plan”订阅服务争夺战。与很多方案相比，Step Plan 更强调 Agent 场景，拥有速度快、聪明且高效的特性，树立自身差异化特点，可以更快速在开发者市场中找到目标用户。此外官方也表示，后续将陆续支持更多模型，进一步扩展到更完整的多模态场景，给开发者带来更多想象空间。 雷峰网文章

excerpt_i18n.en: On March 23, Leifeng News reported that StepFun officially announced the launch of its monthly token subscription plan, Step Plan. This plan is deeply customized for OpenClaw and AI Coding scenarios. It first supports Step 3.5 Flash, a model currently ranked first globally in the OpenRouter weekly total calls chart and first globally in the OpenRouter OpenClaw application monthly calls chart. With the explosive growth of Agent products like OpenClaw, developers are facing significant cost challenges. StepFun's Step Plan offers four different tiers: Flash Mini, Flash Plus, Flash Pro, and Flash Max. The starting price is 49 yuan per month, with a limited-time half-price offer for the developer community as low as 25 yuan per month. Notably, all tiers of Step Plan uniformly provide high-speed inference, without distinguishing between "standard" and "premium" versions. In an industry where many similar products treat high-speed inference as a paid upgrade, StepFun has chosen to make premium speed a standard feature, allowing all users to enjoy it out of the box.
